sections.content: Strings are sequences of characters — text. You can concatenate them, measure length, slice out pieces, and search inside them.
Most languages treat strings as immutable: operations return NEW strings rather than editing in place. This trips up beginners who expect in-place edits.
Key points: quote styles vary (' vs "), escaping handles special characters, and string functions (upper, lower, split, contains) are daily tools.
